findings.category: Liquidity Pool Manipulation / Arbitrary Burn Vector
findings.title: Public / Unrestricted Burn LP Reserve Desynchronization ($8.9M Exploit)
findings.description:
[AUDIT TARGET]: 0x8076c74c5e3f5852037f31ff0093eeb8c8add8d3
[TARGET STATE]: historical deployed version (SafeMoon v1)
[INCIDENT DATE]: 2023-03-28
[EXPLOIT BLOCK]: 26844274 (BSC Mainnet)
[CURRENT ECOSYSTEM]: Migrated to SafeMoon v2 (0x42981d0bfbaf196529376ee702f2a9eb9092fcb5)
[FINDING STATUS]: historical vulnerability

The contract contains a public burn mechanism that allowed burning tokens held directly in the liquidity pair without caller authentication or pair exclusion. On March 28, 2023 at block 26,844,274, an attacker exploited this to burn tokens directly from the PancakeSwap liquidity pool, artificially spiking the spot token price and extracting ~$8.9M of WBNB in the same transaction.
findings.evidence: burn() allows targeting arbitrary holders including Uniswap/PancakeSwap pair contracts
findings.attackScenario: Attacker executes public burn on PancakeSwap pair reserves, artificially skewing the x*y=k invariant, and immediately swaps tokens to siphon underlying WBNB.
findings.recommendation: Quarantine legacy v1 contract; enforce pair address exemption from token destruction and use migrated v2 architecture with immutable liquidity timelocks.
findings.remediationDiff:
- function burn(address from, uint256 amt) public { _burn(from, amt); }
+ function burn(uint256 amt) public { require(msg.sender != pairAddress, 'PAIR_PROTECTED'); _burn(msg.sender, amt); }

findings.title: Centralized Privileged Parameter Risk (Uncapped Fee Setter)
findings.description: Administrative variable '_taxFee' can be dynamically adjusted by the contract owner via setTaxFeePercent() up to 100% without an enforced immutable ceiling. This is an excessive centralized administrative capability rather than an external honeypot exploit; however, an owner key compromise allows 100% transfer taxation across all user transactions.
findings.evidence: function setTaxFeePercent(uint256 taxFee) external onlyOwner { _taxFee = taxFee; }
findings.attackScenario: Owner modifies tax fee to 100%, causing all user sells to be taxed entirely, trapping investor funds.
findings.recommendation: Revoke or lock fee setter to maximum 3% hard ceiling.
findings.remediationDiff:
- function setTaxFeePercent(uint256 fee) external onlyOwner { _taxFee = fee; }
+ function setTaxFeePercent(uint256 fee) external onlyOwner { require(fee <= 3, 'FEE_EXCEEDS_CAP'); _taxFee = fee; }
